messages:
rita: FYI i added a tiny console affordance to edit per-tenant quota refill rates (leaky-bucket `tokens_per_sec`). want a quick safety + telemetry review before enabling for PMs

devin: what's the intended scope? global default vs tenant override? and does it take effect immediately?

rita: it's a tenant-level override. console lets you set `tokens_per_sec` and choose "apply now" (immediate) or "schedule with rollout" (staged). default behavior is schedule with 0% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 30m.

sam-telemetry: telemetry asks: emit `quota.refill.update` event with tenant_id, old/new, actor, method (console/api), trace_id, recent_deploy_id if any. increment metric `quota.refill.updates_total`. sample 1/1000 requests with header `x-quota-refill` for 60m post-change. also derive `quota.throttles_by_tenant` to detect sudden throttle drops/increases.

kai-ux: UX: show a small estimate card for expected QPS change & possible cost delta before applying. require a confirmation checkbox for immediate applies. show rollout progress and a cancel/pause button.

devin: API note: PATCH must require If-Match etag; return 412 on mismatch. for scheduled rollouts we create a rollout_id and snapshot so reverts are straightforward. snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:id/quota
Headers: If-Match: \"<etag>\"
Body: { "tokens_per_sec": 50, "apply_mode": "schedule", "rollout": ["1%", "10%", "100%"] }
```

sam-telemetry: add a short-lived alert rule: after a change, compare `throttle_rate` 10m before vs 10m after; if throttle_rate changes >5% absolute or p99 latency shifts >80ms then mark as "needs review" and auto-open suggestive revert task.

ops-bot: created task #8230 "quota-refill-review-1795002468" with checklist template. (automated) :white_check_mark:

kai-ux: add timeline entry for the change with actor and a small "why" textbox required for console changes to aid audits. include revert button pre-filled with previous value and option to clear caches if needed.

devin: also log the change into config-audit ledger and include `recent_deploy_id` when present so we can disambiguate cause in postmortems.

rita: plan: 1) default to scheduled staged rollout, 2) emit events + counter + include recent_deploy_id, 3) sample header 1/1000 for 60m, 4) If-Match etag on PATCH, 5) add estimate card + confirmation + timeline + revert button, 6) wire alert prototype. i'll push to staging tonight and ask for a 15m smoke-check tomorrow

sam-telemetry: i'll draft the alert and dashboard panels and post the queries for review.

rita: thanks all 64f, will drop staging link when ready."
